entries.requestText: The blue ego vehicle drives through the branching junction, passes a green vehicle at very close quarters, and then turns onto a side lane. Several green vehicles circulate through the surrounding lanes while orange cyclists or scooters also move through the area; by the final frame, multiple green vehicles crowd the upper junction and visibly intersect one another.

The blue ego vehicle travels down the main road, safely passes an oncoming green vehicle, and turns onto the curved side road. An orange cyclist or scooter rider independently follows the loop in the opposite direction; the actors remain separated and no collision occurs.

The blue ego vehicle travels along the multilane road into a large intersection, turns toward the median, and then remains stopped near its tip. Several green vehicles move through or bunch around the intersection and crosswalk while orange cyclists pass through; the cluster includes intersecting vehicle footprints and a cyclist ending against a vehicle.

The blue ego vehicle travels along the divided arterial, enters the large junction, turns left, and then waits near a long green vehicle. Several green vehicles and violet motorcycles move through the junction while multiple orange cyclists or scooters approach and cross nearby; no collision occurs.

The blue ego vehicle follows a curved approach ramp into a large signal-free intersection and begins a left turn onto the main diagonal road. Several cyclists or scooters move on surrounding approaches, while green vehicles and violet motorcycles travel along the main road; the ego enters after a crossing green vehicle has cleared, with no collision or close conflict.

The blue ego vehicle travels steadily north along the divided road and passes several junctions while green vehicles move in the opposite direction and enter or turn from right-side roads; orange and violet two-wheelers also appear on the surrounding roads. Near the end, multiple green vehicles converge at a side-road junction, and a diagonal turning vehicle visibly overlaps a vehicle alongside the ego, producing an unrealistic pileup.
